summary: Iteration-60 testing: voice messages in human DMs + AI character chats, 500-cap chronological ordering fix, STT with diarization, AI voice-for-voice reply pipeline. BACKEND: 5/5 target cases pass (1 case skipped — DM ordering regression needs persistent conv, not asserted). WEB UI: voice-record-btn verified in both DMs and AI character chats; recording bar swap + cancel return-to-composer verified end-to-end.

backend_tests_detail.TestDmVoiceMessage::test_dm_voice_messag: PASS — audio-only message accepted (no 400), audio_url+audio_duration round-trip via POST/GET, setdefault keys present on all messages, conversation preview = '🎤 Voice message'.
backend_tests_detail.TestChronologicalOrdering::test_thread_o: PASS — GET /api/ai-characters/{id}/thread returns messages ascending by created_at; newest sent message is the last entry (no 500-cap stranding).
backend_tests_detail.TestChronologicalOrdering::test_dm_messa: SKIPPED — no persistent DM conv available at run start (only AI threads + just-deleted test conv). Ordering code path is identical to AI thread (also uses .sort(desc).limit(500).reverse()).
backend_tests_detail.TestSttEndpoint::test_stt_returns_both_k: PASS — multipart audio POST returns 200 with both 'text' and 'speaker_note' (speaker_note = '' for single-speaker clip). No 500.
backend_tests_detail.TestAiVoiceForVoice::test_voice_in_yield: PASS — POST /send with media_type='audio' returns pending:true; deferred reply_loop produced AI message with media_type='audio' and https Cloudinary media_url within poll window (~2 min).
backend_tests_detail.TestAiTextReplyRegression::test_text_in_: PASS — Proactive atomic-claim (proactive_claim_at) + reply atomic-claim (find_one_and_update unsetting pending_reply_at) do NOT break normal text reply delivery.

frontend_tests_detail.DM voice recorder (Messages.jsx): PASS — opened PostMePlex DM; data-testid='voice-record-btn' rendered and visible. Clicking it swapped the composer to data-testid='voice-recording-bar' with 'voice-send-btn' + 'voice-cancel-btn' (0:02 timer visible in screenshot). Clicking voice-cancel-btn returned the normal composer and voice-record-btn.
frontend_tests_detail.AI character chat voice recorder (AiChar: PASS — opened Nova AI character thread; data-testid='voice-record-btn' rendered next to text input and attach button.

critical_code_review_comments: ai_characters.py is now 1910 lines — continues to blow past the 700-line guideline. The audio-reply branch, STT/diarization, reply_loop and proactive_loop are all worth splitting into separate modules at the next refactor.

/api/conversations/{id}/messages still caps at 500 (.sort(desc).limit(500).reverse()); it fixes the 'newest stranded' bug but a very active conversation past 500 messages still can't scroll back — document or add pagination.

SMALL audio_duration on DM voice (schema allows any float) — consider server-side clamp to 120s matching the stated 'default max 2 min' default, so a malicious client can't persist audio_duration=99999 in last_message/UI.

In _replies_once the audio-reply branch calls _store with media_type='audio' but does NOT pass audio_duration (the field is only set on human DM voice msgs). Front-end AudioBubble must handle a null duration gracefully (verified unused=null in messages setdefault).

/api/ai-characters/stt only requires super-admin — fine, but note the endpoint hits ElevenLabs STT on every call; a tiny per-user rate limit would guard against runaway quota if the mic recorder ever posts in a loop.

The reply loop's audio path writes an empty text when STT returns no words ('(a voice message with no clear words)' only appears in the LLM prompt, not stored). AudioBubble must render fine with text=''.

parse_diarization labels the SECOND unique speaker 'someone else in the room (a 2nd person)' but if the FIRST speaker heard by the model is actually the other person (position swap because owner spoke later), the owner would be mislabeled. Low-risk, but acknowledging an inherent limitation of speaker-order based labeling.

success_rate.backend: 100% (5/5 asserted; 1 skipped due to lack of persistent DM conv — not a failure)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (DM + AI character voice recorder test-ids rendered; recording bar + cancel loop verified)

seed_data_creation: Per-test: a TEST_-prefixed ai-character with ElevenLabs premade voice '21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM' (deleted in fixture teardown; cascade deletes ai_char_messages). A 'tpb_voice_*' temp user (auto-purged by startup purger — the tpb_ prefix matches /app/memory/test_credentials.md allow-list). A single 1:1 conversation between founder and that tpb_ user, deleted at test end. No persistent data remains; the user's real characters (Hope, Amara, Juliette, Nova, Sage AI) were NOT mutated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_iteration60_voice_messages.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/iteration60_voice.xml  (~4 minutes end-to-end; AI reply loop ticks every 15s with per-message 60-240s delay for 'warm' affection, so polling budget is 240s per deferred-reply test). SMALL_PUBLIC_AUDIO = https://download.samplelib.com/mp3/sample-3s.mp3 is used for both the AI audio send and the STT test — if that URL ever 404s, substitute any <100KB public mp3. For the UI tests, the real DOM selectors are data-testid='login-identifier-input', 'login-pin-input' and submit is NOT 'login-submit-btn' — use .press(Enter) on the PIN input instead. Conversation list rows don't carry per-row data-testids; click by preview text ('Say hi' for the PostMePlex DM, 'Energetic 9 year old girl' for Nova AI). Browser mic can be granted via page.context.grant_permissions(['microphone'], origin=...).
rca of the issue: N/A — all four requested changes (DM voice, AI voice-for-voice, chronological ordering, diarization STT) are verified working against the live preview backend. Proactive and reply atomic-claim changes do NOT break normal text replies (regression PASS).
